title: Domain-separate and version the Announce origin signature transcript
description: P2 security/interoperability: AnnounceMessage.signed_data() signs raw IID||pubkey||seq||rx_channel||app_data with no protocol/domain/version prefix, unlike Link and DAO Schnorr-48 transcripts. Reusing the node identity key across protocol roles leaves Announce signatures without cryptographic context binding and makes future transcript evolution ambiguous. Define a fixed LICHEN-ANNOUNCE-vN domain (with unambiguous delimiter/length framing), update the normative spec and all implementations/vectors together, and add cross-domain negative KATs proving Link/DAO/SOS material is rejected as Announce authority.
